release_notes: The Hikvision DS-2TD4668-35A4 is a portable bi-spectrum (640x512 thermal + 4 MP optical) PTZ camera with temperature measurement (-20 to 150 C), fire detection, GPS and 4G/Wi-Fi transmission on a magnetic battery base for temporary deployments such as substations. Verified against the official Hikvision datasheet.

home_assistant.notes: Hikvision-platform ONVIF (default port 80). Optical is Channel 1 and thermal is Channel 2, exposed as separate streams. PTZ via ONVIF.
